node.title: Re: Use case for symbolic references (was: Re^2: Referencing the locals)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Is there ever a case to use a symbolic reference in Perl?

Two places that come to mind where I regularly write no strict 'refs'; is dynamic method/function generation ([id://1197627|example 1], [id://11102243|example 2]) and implementations of import ([id://1198421|example 1], [id://1187386|example 2], at the bottom of each node). Other than those legitimate uses, there's interaction with legacy code ([id://1229810|example 1], [id://1229818|example 2]). Note how in each of those examples the scope of the no strict is limited to be as small as possible.

Update: Added more links to examples.
